svg.title: Perfection loop — how to tie it
svg.desc: Perfection loop, in 6 steps. Form a loop with the tag behind the standing line. Form a second, smaller loop in front of the first, holding both. Bring the tag between the two loops. Pass the second loop through the first. Wet and pull the new loop and the standing line apart to seat. Trim the tag.
